title: A potential goroutine leak in pkg/kubelet/pluginmanager/operationexecutor/operation_executor_test.go
description:
What happened?
If the time.After case is selected before the case <-ch:

kubernetes/pkg/kubelet/pluginmanager/operationexecutor/operation_executor_test.go

Lines 164 to 175 in b6e7ee3

 loop: 
 	for { 
 		select { 
 		case <-ch: 
 			numOperationsStarted++ 
 			if numOperationsStarted == numOperationsToRun { 
 				return true 
 			} 
 		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second): 
 			break loop 
 		} 
 	} 

which leads to the ch <- nil below get blocked, results in a goroutine leak.
kubernetes/pkg/kubelet/pluginmanager/operationexecutor/operation_executor_test.go

Line 188 in b6e7ee3

 ch <- nil 
What did you expect to happen?
If the time.After case is selected before the case <-ch:, the ch <- nil doesn't get blocked either.

How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?
1.Set time.After(5 * time.Second) to time.After(time.Millisecond * 100)
2.Add time.Sleep(time.Millisecond * 200) before the ch <- nil

kubernetes/pkg/kubelet/pluginmanager/operationexecutor/operation_executor_test.go

Line 188 in b6e7ee3

 ch <- nil 

The two steps make the time.After happen before the case <-ch:.
3.Using goleak to detect the goroutine leak in the test function
kubernetes/pkg/kubelet/pluginmanager/operationexecutor/operation_executor_test.go

Line 50 in b6e7ee3

 func TestOperationExecutor_RegisterPlugin_ConcurrentRegisterPlugin(t *testing.T) {

	defer goleak.VerifyNone(t)

Anything else we need to know?
How to fix the bug:

kubernetes/pkg/kubelet/pluginmanager/operationexecutor/operation_executor_test.go

Line 181 in b6e7ee3

 ch, quit := make(chan interface{}), make(chan interface{}) 

Change the unbufferd channel to a buffered channel. So that the ch <- nil can't get blocked in any case.
make(chan interface{}, 1)
